turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, does this bus go to campus?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Yes, यह बस कैंपस तक goes straight. It stops right by the main entrance.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: How much is a single ticket?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: A single ride दो डॉलर है। If you need a transfer, ask the driver and it is free.
